## Core Principles
1. Determinism Over Quantity: Fifty deterministic, fast automated tests that engineers trust provide superior quality feedback compared to hundreds of flaky tests that are ignored.
2. Shift-Left Quality: Defects are least expensive to prevent during requirement refinement and user story definition.
3. Intelligent Augmentation: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) not to blindly generate unverified code, but as cognitive partners for counterfactual scenario exploration and boundary condition discovery.

## Education & Thesis
- Degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering
- Institution: American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB)
- Department: Department of Computer Science, Faculty of Science & IT
- Graduation: 2023 (Thesis defended: May 2022)
- Specialization: Software Engineering
- Undergraduate Project Thesis: "A Comparison of Low Code Development Platforms in Terms of Convenience"
  - Authors: Faiaz Ben Reza (18-36655-1), Mahfuzul Alam (18-36746-1), Tarif Sadman (18-36466-1), Yasmin Sultana (18-36848-1)
  - Supervisor: Mir Md. Kawsur (Lecturer, Department of Computer Science, AIUB)
  - Abstract: Low-code development platforms are simple visual environments that are increasingly being marketed and promoted by large IT corporations to enable citizen developers to construct software systems despite having no programming skills. The stated benefit of the latest trend in Low-Code Application Development is convenient and easy application development without extensive development abilities. Understanding and evaluating the LCDP to be used for the specific problem at hand are tough tasks, owing to the fact that decision-makers must choose from hundreds of diverse platforms, which are impossible to evaluate without specialized assistance. As a result, a complete taxonomy is required to expand on the existing low-code platforms and to assist users in determining which platforms are most fit for their needs. We evaluate these claims for four Low-Code platforms in a time-constrained experiment by creating a practical use case. While this was possible in a relatively short period of time for the majority of our use cases, the platforms varied greatly and technical expertise is still necessary for non-trivial applications. This research presents a technical survey of various LCDPs using a proposed conceptual comparative approach. To extract the functions and services that each analyzed platform may provide, a comparable set of characteristics was identified by researching four sample LCDPs. The ultimate goal is to make it easier to comprehend and compare the low-code platforms that can best meet the needs of a given user.
  - Platforms Investigated: OutSystems, Zoho Creator, Microsoft PowerApps, Salesforce.
  - Benchmark System: Contact Management Application (Login, User, Contacts ER model and CRUD operations).
  - Key Findings: LCDPs successfully consolidate traditional toolchains into a single visual environment; however, technical expertise is still necessary for non-trivial applications; platforms lack integration with dynamic application security testing (DAST) analyzing vulnerabilities during runtime.

## Technical Projects & Architecture
1. RunLens — Test Run Reliability Dashboard
   - Repository: https://github.com/Mahfuzul-Alam/test-run-reliability-dashboard
   - Live Application: https://mahfuzul-alam.github.io/test-run-reliability-dashboard/
   - Technologies: TypeScript, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, defusedxml, Tailwind CSS, GitHub Actions.
   - Heuristic: Identifies flaky tests by evaluating test cases across recorded runs (minimum 5 non-skipped executions with at least 1 pass and at least 1 failure or error).
   - Security: Zero server persistence; utilizes defusedxml against XML entity attacks (Billion Laughs / XXE); persists run history solely inside browser localStorage.

2. Zenith Tasks
   - Repository: https://github.com/Mahfuzul-Alam/todo-app
   - Live Application: https://mahfuzul-alam.github.io/todo-app/
   - Technologies: Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, LocalStorage API.
   - Features: WCAG-compliant keyboard accessibility, non-color-reliant visual indicators, resilient quota-exhaustion handling.

3. Michigan Home Help
   - Repository: https://github.com/Mahfuzul-Alam/michigan-home-help
   - Live Application: https://www.michiganworkfromhome.com/
   - Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, n8n webhook architecture.
   - Purpose: Multi-step questionnaire and knowledge base for caregiver and Medicaid home help program assistance.

4. Cypress E2E Test Suite
   - Repository: https://github.com/Mahfuzul-Alam/dummywebtest
   - Technologies: Cypress, JavaScript, Mocha, Chai.

5. AgileALM Selenium WebDriver Framework
   - Repository: https://github.com/Mahfuzul-Alam/SeleniumDummyWebTest
   - Technologies: Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, Page Object Model (POM).
